name: overflow-recovery
description: (project.drop removes compaction_end result.estimatedTokensAfter and tokensBefore: Pi 1.5.0 and PiG count the host's own system prompt wording in them (2566 vs 2548, 2436 vs 2418 here); see port/lane-HarnessExt.md Findings.) The provider rejects the request as a context overflow (HTTP 400, the shape src of the real-Pi suite scripts: "prompt is too long: 300000 tokens > 100000 maximum"). With keepRecentTokens=1 Pi runs its overflow compaction, posthorse answers session_before_compact with a recovery record (no summarization request), Pi retries once, the second overflow is final (official-host.ts 'eligible overflow recovery (keepRecentTokens=1) retries once without summarization'; src/rollover.ts, src/retention.ts).
